issue_context.title: Configure separator for validation error message
issue_context.body:
## 🚀 Feature Proposal

Allow configurability of separator for schema validation errors message. Currently when there are multiple errors it is a comma separated string.

https://github.com/fastify/fastify/blob/master/lib/validation.js#L124

## Motivation

1. We require using custom error messages that have commas in them ex: 'should only contain letters, numbers or a hyphen'
2. When there are multiple error messages and there is no provision to configure the delimiter, we are forced to avoid using commas in our custom error messages.

## Example

```
const fastify = Fastify({
  ajv: {
    customOptions: { jsonPointers: true, separator: ';' },
    plugins: [
      require('ajv-errors')
    ]
  }
})
```

If there is a validation Error, the validationError would be separated by the specified delimiter 
For example: validatonError.message = "should be of pattern ^v1; should not exceed 10 characters"
